period.scope: Selected source-checked regulatory and participation dates plus clearly identified internal reviews; not exhaustive, not legal advice or automatic obligation

events.title: CRA reporting obligations began; operational relevance throughout this window
events.action: Prepare an evidence custody example for manufacturers. Applicability and incident reporting remain human decisions; no claim that a GSPC card satisfies CRA.

events.title: EU data sovereignty consultation closes 23:59 CEST
events.action: Review draft contribution on declared versus observed routing metadata and portable evidence. Submit only after explicit authorization.

events.title: NIST public-facing AI documentation input date; exact cutoff time unspecified
events.action: Finalize existing NIST draft with measured, missing, and unsigned examples and AI-assistance disclosure. Submit only after explicit authorization.

events.title: Internal 14-day revenue and evidence review; not a regulatory deadline
events.action: Reconcile actual settlement growth, repeat purchases, evidence freshness, useful completed runs and index coverage. Do not infer ARR from test transactions.

events.title: Internal CSOAI seven-day revenue, GSPC freshness, indexed x402 discovery and human-authority gap review (NOT an external deadline)
events.action: Read the existing measured/unknown states, reconcile signed root and paying customer evidence separately; do not claim new sales, regulation approval or staffed HITL without receiving-party proof.

events.title: EU AI Act Service Desk: Article 50(2) transitional milestone for specified existing synthetic-content AI providers; CSOAI applicability not determined
events.action: Review the current official consolidated text, check whether any Council/MEOK public-facing outputs are in scope, assign legal applicability to a qualified human; do not interpret this date-only reference as an exact UTC submission cutoff or compliance finding.

events.title: Ofgem AI assurance consultation: first optional stakeholder workshop, 11:00–12:30 GMT (event, NOT filing deadline)
events.action: Consider optional workshop participation and assess relevance of source-pinned evidence and independent-effect assurance; any registration requires separately authorised human action.

events.title: Ofgem consultation on AI assurance guidance in the energy sector closes 23:59 GMT, 15 January 2027
events.action: Review the proposed guidance and prepare factual, rights-cleared examples on source identity, frozen methods, unqualified versus qualified outcomes and real independent acceptance; send only after company owner reviews and explicitly authorises a response. Consultation is not a grant or award.
